_comment: Scribe (Ice and Fire). Copying, which is the least glamorous way a thing survives.
The §12.4 anchors are the page, ink, errors, commissions, the archive and a text she does not
believe. These three take an error she has found running through generations of copies, eyes that
are beginning to fail, and an account she is required to copy and does not credit.
Her central conviction is that a copyist has no right to improve a text. She writes what is there,
marks what is doubtful, and keeps her own opinion in the margin where the next reader can weigh it
Every episode carries an integrations gate, because this profession only exists when Ice and Fire
